Place a self-hosted ONNX Runtime Web browser bundle here as `ort.min.js`, together with the matching WASM runtime assets distributed with that exact version (for example `ort-wasm.wasm` and/or SIMD variants). The bundle must expose the `ort` browser global. The app intentionally does not load the runtime from a CDN. Obtain it from the official ONNX Runtime Web distribution, verify its version and licence, and add the runtime and model files to the service-worker precache list before expecting offline model loading.
